<title level="1" right="Class Feature 1">[Esoteric Lore](/Classes.aspx?ID=22)</title>

<column gap="tiny">
**Source** [Dark Archive](/Sources.aspx?ID=129) pg. 30

**Class** Thaumaturge
</column>

---

Your experience with the unknown, as well as the tales you've exchanged with other thaumaturges, has taught you about strange phenomena of every kind. You become trained in [Esoteric Lore](/Skills.aspx?ID=8), a special lore skill that can be used to [Recall Knowledge](/Actions.aspx?ID=26) regarding [haunts](/Traits.aspx?ID=88), [curses](/Traits.aspx?ID=38), and creatures of any type, but that can't be used to Recall Knowledge of other topics. Unlike a normal Lore skill, you use Charisma as your modifier on Esoteric Lore checks. You also gain the [Dubious Knowledge](/Feats.aspx?ID=776) skill feat.

 At 3rd level, you become an expert in Esoteric Lore; at 7th level, you become a master in Esoteric Lore; and at 15th level, you become legendary in Esoteric Lore.
name: Esoteric Lore
